channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: New Bamboo Orchids Terminal in Guwahati to handle 13.1million passengers per year
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the new terminal on December 20

item.title: Unauthorised bus stands & random stops turn Guwahati roads into gridlock
item.description: 68% of respondents among the force admitted that the number of personnel engaged in traffic management is insufficient to control the growing congestion.

item.title: Nine Jewish Rabbis conclude weeklong screening of Bnei Menashe in Mizoram
item.description: 35 visitors including the rabbis, officials of the Jewish Agency for Israel and diplomats from the Israeli Embassy, had been camping in the Mizoram since December 1 to identify people.

item.title: 26th Hornbill Festival concludes, showcasing Naga heritage, dance, & music
item.description: Nagaland Deputy Chief Minister TR Zeliang, Miss Nagaland 2025 Linoka K Achumi, and other dignitaries lit the ritualistic bonfire marking the formal culmination of the festival.

item.title: NFR workers protest privatisation, cite risks to employees & passengers
item.description: General secretary of the NF Railway Employees’ Union, pointed at the recent crisis of the IndiGo airline, & cautioned that similar chaos could arise in the railways.

item.title: Fewer migratory birds recorded in Kamrup this year: Conservationist
item.description: Large scale poaching and human disturbances in the Brahmaputra and its nearby areas have been adversely affecting the habitat of the migratory birds.

item.title: Centre approves transfer of 35 critically endangered vultures to Kaziranga division
item.description: The vultures will be transferred to the Bishwanath Wildlife Division, the sixth addition to the Kaziranga National Park (KNP) and Tiger Reserve.

item.title: Lumding Civil Hospital crumbles a year after opening, leaving patients in distress
item.description: Locals claimed that many of them have been avoiding coming back to the hospital due to the absence of basic facilities.

item.title: Indian Railways ranks as the world’s second-largest freight carrier: Minister
